snippet.title: VERHO - Whispers of the Wind (DLC) - Coming Early 2027
snippet.description:
The shore of an island lying within the Great Lake in the northern reaches of Yariv. Ancient chronicles tell that, before the coming of the Curse, this place served as the proving grounds for future King's Protectors. At the island's heart stood the mighty fortress of House Azakar, whose bloodline commanded the King's Protectors for generations and defended the kingdom until the day the Curse consumed all.

Verho - Whispers of the Wind is a DLC for Verho - Curse of Faces and brings you to a brand-new location, with more secrets, valuable new equipment, mysterious challenges, and a new storyline that can affect the ending of the base game. 

Coming Early 2027 - Wishlist Now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4917220/
